content: The Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm is an ornate mystical debate between the sword and the pen, like the R. ʿAql u ʿIshq: the courtly elite of the banqueting hall of Beauty against the warlike rulers of the court of Majesty, each arguing from reason and tradition, until Sulṭān ʿIshq judges that both further all worldly and religious affairs equally; it is unpublished.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm
